judged_text: The if/else block is closed with `<%- end if %>`, which ERB/Erubis compiles to `...; end if; _erbout << ...` — `end if` with no condition expression is a Ruby SyntaxError raised the first time the template is compiled. Every GET /embed/best that reaches rendering raises a template SyntaxError and returns 500, so the entire embed feature is dead on arrival; the new controller spec does not enable render_views, so CI stays green while production is red (a stand-in guard).
